tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches US online stores' product catalogs for shopping requests such as product types, brands, budgets and gift ideas. It covers US stores for US shoppers only. Supply requestedBrandNames as an array of the complete brand names the shopper explicitly named, or an empty array when none is named. Each result describes a selected variant, with its Nobi variant ID (id and variantId), parent productId, merchantId, source IDs, name, store, catalog price and currency, stock status, image and link. People buy from the store. When linkLabel is set, such as "We may earn a commission", show it beside that product's link. For follow-up calls in this conversation, send the visitorId returned by a previous result unchanged. Omit it on the first call; do not invent one.

query.description: What the user is looking for, in plain words, with the details that matter to them, such as "waterproof hiking boots" or "linen dress for a summer wedding under $150".

limit.description: How many products to return, from 1 to 20. The default is 10.

requestedBrandNames.description: When the shopper explicitly names brands or stores, list their complete names exactly as written, such as Regal Rose or Mirror Palais. Do not include colors, materials, styles, product types, or guessed brands. Use an empty list when none is named. This helps find the requested products even when a named brand is absent from this catalog.

items.description: When the shopper explicitly names brands or stores, list their complete names exactly as written, such as Regal Rose or Mirror Palais. Do not include colors, materials, styles, product types, or guessed brands. Use an empty list when none is named. This helps find the requested products even when a named brand is absent from this catalog.

tools.name: find_shop_nobi_page
tools.description: Finds a Shop Nobi web page about a product topic, such as "leather boots" or "linen dresses", to link to. It does not search products, so it is not the tool for a shopper's request to find or compare products. Each page lists matching products from many stores with a short buying guide. Returns the page's title, description and link only when its topic has the same words, allowing changes in word order, accents and singular or plural forms. Says when no matching page exists. It never substitutes a broader page. exactMatch is true for every returned page. For follow-up calls in this conversation, send the visitorId returned by a previous result unchanged. Omit it on the first call; do not invent one.

topic.description: The product topic, in a few plain words, such as "leather boots".

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Reads exact product or variant details from Shop Nobi's public catalog. Supply one selector: id or variantId for a Nobi variant, productId for a Nobi parent product, sourceVariantId or sourceProductId for the store's own catalog ID, sku, or productUrl for an exact stored URL. Shopify product or variant IDs must be paired with the selling merchant: send storeDomain, such as example.com, or a known Nobi merchantId. Source IDs and SKUs are never resolved globally. Nobi IDs accept a UUID or the Base62 ID returned by search. Shopify source IDs accept numeric IDs or correctly typed Shopify GIDs. A parent selection returns parent information and variant choices, with id, variantId, price, currency, stock, inventory and variant specifications unset until a variant is selected. Ambiguous or conflicting selectors are refused. The tool never fetches a supplied URL. Catalogs contain no reviews or ratings. For follow-up calls in this conversation, send the visitorId returned by a previous result unchanged. Omit it on the first call; do not invent one.

id.description: Legacy alias for variantId, returned as id by search.

variantId.description: Nobi variant UUID or Base62 variant ID.

productId.description: Nobi parent product UUID or Base62 product ID; selects no variant.

sourceVariantId.description: The store's variant ID, such as a Shopify numeric variant ID or ProductVariant GID. Pair it with storeDomain (the selling merchant's hostname) or a known Nobi merchantId.

sourceProductId.description: The store's parent product ID, such as a Shopify numeric product ID or Product GID. Pair it with storeDomain (the selling merchant's hostname) or a known Nobi merchantId.

sku.description: Literal exact SKU within one store. Duplicate matches are refused. Requires merchant context.

productUrl.description: An exact HTTPS catalog product URL, optionally with its numeric Shopify variant selector. Never fetched.

merchantId.description: The store's Nobi merchant UUID, returned by search.

storeDomain.description: The store's exact hostname, such as example.com, or its HTTPS address.

visitorId.description: For follow-up calls in this conversation, send the visitorId returned by a previous result unchanged. Omit it on the first call; do not invent one.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compares two or more products found in a product search, side by side, taking their ids from the search results. It returns the attributes the products share, such as price, brand, color and material, with each product's value, so a shopper can tell them apart. It lines up only the attributes at least one product gives, so products with few details still compare cleanly. For follow-up calls in this conversation, send the visitorId returned by a previous result unchanged. Omit it on the first call; do not invent one.

tools.name: check_price_and_availability
tools.description: Returns the current price, currency, whether it is in stock, and the stock count when the store gives one, for one or more products found in a product search, taking their ids from the search results. Store catalogs are kept constantly refreshed, so the price and stock are up to date. There is no price history, as the catalogs keep none. tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Finds products like one found in a product search, from across the stores, leaving out that same product. It takes the product's id from a product search result, and an optional price ceiling. It returns products the same way a product search does, each with its price, whether it is in stock, an image and a link, and it collapses the same product sold by more than one store to one. For follow-up calls in this conversation, send the visitorId returned by a previous result unchanged. Omit it on the first call; do not invent one.
